name: e-invoicing-tr-currency-codes
title: UBL-TR currency codes (e-Fatura)
description: Currency codes accepted by the GİB UBL-TR schematron for Turkish e-documents (e-Fatura, e-Arşiv Fatura and others) in DocumentCurrencyCode, TaxCurrencyCode, PricingCurrencyCode, PaymentCurrencyCode, PaymentAlternativeCurrencyCode and currencyID attributes, with their status in ISO 4217.

sources.title: e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (CurrencyCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01, file dated 2026-08-21), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-05
e-Fatura Mevzuat ve Teknik Kılavuzlar, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı
ISO 4217 List One and List Three, SIX Financial Information, used for iso_4217_status (see world-currencies)

fields.name: code
fields.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code accepted by the UBL-TR schematron. References code in world-currencies (currencies or historic-currencies).

fields.name: iso_4217_status
fields.description: current when the code is in ISO 4217 List One (published 2026-09-17); withdrawn when it is only in List Three (historic). GİB still accepts these withdrawn codes.
